title: fix(plugin-grid): a grid row's Edit or Delete greyed by disabledWhen says why
body:
Fixes #35334

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表网格（plugin-grid ObjectGrid）行菜单里的内置「编辑」「删除」，在对象声明的 `userActions.*.disabledWhen` 成立而变灰时，现在多一行说明「Not available for this record」（已有的 `actions.notAvailableForRecord` 文案，各语言已翻译），并作为该菜单项的无障碍描述；菜单项名称仍是原标签。
- 为什么改：记录页（#35288）和 data-table 行菜单（#35331）已按裁决 6996106574 的 B 路线给出原因，plugin-grid 行菜单是同一缺口的第三处，用户看到灰掉的按钮却不知道为什么。
- 风险与回滚：仅改 `RowActionMenu.tsx` 中 `BuiltinRowActionItem` 的渲染，不动协议、不加 i18n 键、不加导出；权限判定仍在加载（`verdictPending`）时只置灰不给原因。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx` 的 `BuiltinRowActionItem`（喂给 `useDisabledReason` 的只是 `disabledByPredicate`，不含 `verdictPending`）；其次 `RowActionMenu.test.tsx` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/components/__tests__/RowActionMenu.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中 objectstack#35334 那组 6 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`BuiltinRowActionItem` (the built-in row Edit / Delete in the plugin-grid "⋮" menu) now applies route B per ruling 6996106574, matching the data-table row item:

- `disabledByPredicate = predicates?.disabledWhen != null && isDisabled` — the declared `disabledWhen` verdict alone — is what `useDisabledReason` receives. The item's `disabled` prop stays `verdictPending || disabledByPredicate`, so an item greyed only because its record-grained verdict is still loading earns no reason.
- `useDisabledReason` is called with the other hooks, ahead of the `!isVisible` early return.
- When there is a reason: `menuItemReasonAria(reason)` on the item (accessible name stays the label via `aria-labelledby`, the reason is `aria-describedby`), and `DisabledReasonMenuLabel` draws it as a visible second line. No reason: bare label, as before.

The helpers were already imported by this file (the custom-action item uses them) and are exported from the `@object-ui/components` package entry, so there is no new import surface and no new export. No new i18n key; no `packages/spec` change.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in the existing shared harness `RowActionMenu.test.tsx` (objectstack#35334):

- Edit and Delete greyed by `disabledWhen`: `aria-disabled`, `aria-describedby` points at a visible element reading "Not available for this record", and `getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Edit' | 'Delete' })` is the item.
- CONTROL — no predicate: no `aria-describedby`, no reason text.
- CONTROL — predicate not holding: enabled, no reason.
- CONTROL — pending verdict (no predicate, and predicate not holding): `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy` true, yet no `aria-describedby` and no reason text.

## Acceptance notes

- A row whose `disabledWhen` holds AND whose record-grained verdict is pending shows the reason: the reason follows the resolved `disabledWhen` verdict, which is true and evaluated client-side; only the pending leg on its own earns none. Not pinned separately.
